name: Flynn
description: Administration suite for Jellyfin: maintenance, dashboards, capacity forecasting and library care.
overview: One plugin, many modules you switch on individually. He fights for the Users.

versions.changelog: Hardens the disk grouping that v0.3.0 introduced. Grouping by kernel device id is correct for bind mounts of one dataset, which is the common case, but ZFS gives every dataset its own superblock and therefore its own device id while they all draw on the same pool. Splitting a library into its own dataset would have quietly restored the double counting. Pooled filesystems are now grouped by pool. Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or later.

Fixes storage figures on any server that bind-mounts one pool at several paths, which is what a Docker media server normally does. Flynn was reporting one filesystem once per mount and counting its free space over again each time; on a ZFS box with six libraries on one pool that overstates headroom sixfold, and a capacity forecast built on it would have been confidently wrong. It now reads the kernel's mount table and groups by filesystem, and names the pool the way you named it rather than by a container path. Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or later.

Finishes the French translation. The page was showing accentless text -- Degrade, a l'instant -- and the size unit stayed English, so a French reader got 19,5 TB with a French comma and an English unit. Module names and descriptions were English literals too. Everything user-facing now comes from the catalogue, units included. Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or later.

Modules are now grouped by category on the dashboard, so the page stays readable as more of them arrive. Gives Flynn a look of its own: cyan for normal, amber for attention, on cards that lift slightly off the page. Colours are accents only -- edges, dots, the switch -- never the surface text sits on, so light Jellyfin themes stay readable. Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or later.

Fixes a defect that made v0.1.0 useless: modules showed as Disabled with no way to switch them on. A module the admin has never configured now falls back to its own default rather than to off, and every card has a toggle. The admin page also had English hard-coded in its script; all of its labels now come from the same catalogue as everything else, so the whole page follows your language instead of half of it.

First installable build. Adds the Storage module: how much each library holds and how much room is left on each device, measured nightly at 03:15. Needs no third-party plugin -- Flynn delivers its own client script, unlike the JavaScript Injector route which has no Jellyfin 12 build. Changes nothing by default: the write level starts at none and every module is read-only. Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or later.
